900.2.10(737).explanation: Exception R 737 covers a set of named addresses in the R zone. Two site-specific provisions apply to single properties (two dwelling units at 64 Glenlake Ave.; medical office and office uses at 209 Mavety Street), and 21 entries name former City of Toronto by-laws or sections that prevail on listed addresses. All of these apply only to the named properties and are not evaluated for other lots; if your lot is one of them, the named instrument may govern instead of By-law 569-2013.
